p1.title: R1-R6 do not explicitly close the independent M527 configuration-registry gate
p1.evidence: M624 reports m527_configuration_registry_ready=false. R5 covers operator scope/fixed numerator, while R6 covers unified CPU source/common resource schema but does not require the M527 common-resource manifest and five SHA-bound executable configuration manifests with charge/fallback policies.
p1.impact: The current fail-closed null result remains valid, but completing the six written actions is not sufficient to make the next audit ready.
p1.required_fix: Keep six items but extend R6 to create, double-seal and validate the M527 common-resource manifest and B0/B1/B2/B3/Ours executable configuration manifests before fresh static review.

p2.title: Future decoder verification is represented by directory existence only
p2.evidence: decoder_ready is the conjunction of three Path.is_dir checks and does not validate package schemas, member manifests, outer seals, populations or identity.
p2.impact: No effect on this snapshot because all three directories are absent and multiple other gates are false; unsafe for a superseding readiness audit.
p2.required_fix: Validate exact M511/M578 schema, population, member hashes, outer seals and checkpoint/config identity in the next analyzer.

decision.only_allowed_next_step: Supersede R6 and decoder package verification, then request another fresh static hammer before any production simulation.
